all_pass.bar: recall>=0.6 & >=20x over random
all_pass.detail: tissue model recovers textbook cell-cell signaling axes in the right cells

all_pass.bar: recover a known target in >=60% of >=5 OOD diseases & aggregate strong-precision >=1.5x random-label
all_pass.detail: 3-layer pipeline (causal->perturb-to-wildtype->druggability) selects the real drug target blind on 5/6 OOD diseases

all_pass.bar: driver recall>=0.7 & suppressor flagged protector & separation>=0.5
all_pass.detail: measured knockout effects separate DRIVER from PROTECTOR (real interventional causality)

all_pass.bar: link>=0.7 & perturb-dir>=0.7 & drug>=0.7 & struct-fn>=0.65
all_pass.detail: learned graph model: predicts binding, downstream direction, drug off-targets, function

all_pass.bar: no fitted correction beats CatPred-as-is on real measurements (optimal shrinkage=1.0)
all_pass.detail: measured kcat kept as ground truth; the 'recalibration win' is a label-quality artifact, not adopted

all_pass.bar: S669 blind Pearson>=0.38 & anti-symmetry corr>=0.9 (0.472, beats ACDC-NN via ProteinMPNN)
all_pass.detail: predicts mutation stability ΔΔG (structure ProteinMPNN + biophysical); top-benchmark; mutation->phenotype keystone

all_pass.bar: trained GraphSAGE beats fixed SIGN propagation on PPI link AUC (Δ>0.01) & wins >=2/3 relations
all_pass.detail: the GPU-tier learned encoder measurably improves link prediction over fixed message-passing

all_pass.bar: FBA gene-deletion precision-lift>=3x & dominance reproduced (buffered@50%>=0.8, collapse@KO<=0.2)
all_pass.detail: enzyme-constrained Human-GEM: known essential genes recovered + quantitative mutation->flux (dominance)

all_pass.bar: external canonical markers: min specificity>=0.4 across>=5 lineages & mean>=4x background
all_pass.detail: emask gate is cell-type-specific (markers land in their own lineage ~9x background) -> conditioned answers are correct; honest negatives (no predictive lift) recorded, not gated

all_pass.bar: measured ppm×kcat covers>=70% central-carbon enzymes & Vmax spread(log10 std)>=0.5
all_pass.detail: per-enzyme capacity is data-backed (measured abundance×kcat); buffered-vs-dose-sensitive is measured, not assumed

baseline.sequence_methods: fail in the <30% seqId twilight zone

all_pass.bar: function keyword-match accuracy>=0.8 on>=4 proteins & >=2 recovered via a <30% seqId structural homolog
all_pass.detail: AlphaFold structure + Foldseek transfers correct function, incl. from twilight-zone homologs sequence methods miss

all_pass.bar: mutation→ΔΔG→flux chain: precision(pathogenic|ΔΔG>1) >= 1.4x base (high-precision destabilization detector)
all_pass.detail: one validated pipeline mutation→phenotype; high-precision LOW-recall (AUC~0.5 as a general classifier — honest scope)

all_pass.bar: anomaly engine's completion proposals recover held-out real edges at triadic-closure AUC >= 0.75
all_pass.detail: model checks itself: hard-constraint > measured > predicted; flags never auto-applied; completions validated leakage-free

all_pass.bar: AlphaMissense beats the stability chain by >=0.1 AUC AND the sickle-cell GOF blind spot is flagged (not trusted benign)
all_pass.detail: reliable+reasoned variant call: AlphaMissense drives accuracy, mechanism rungs explain, GOF pattern overrides false-benign (the sickle-cell lesson)

all_pass.bar: verified fixes resolve the oddness (physics restored / shared-complex); measured values ESCALATED not auto-applied; no false fixes
all_pass.detail: fill-and-verify: propose a fix, re-run the mechanism, report only what verifiably resolves — the anti-trap loop

all_pass.bar: function de-ghosts >=3000 (curated literature) & predicted pathway agrees with function theme >=0.4 & >=1.8x shuffled
all_pass.detail: ghost genes patched into the cell: function (fact tier) + pathway membership (prediction tier, cross-validated by the independent function signal)
